title: A Nose Full Of Wonder - Children's Picture Book, Hardcover
description:
Humans look up. Pepper sniffs. title: Puppy Meets the Mona Lisa - Framed Art Print, Brass Plaque
description:
A famous lady with a mysterious smile, and one small dog smiling right back.

From the Pepper the Dog picture book Pepper's Museum Shock, Pepper sits before the world's most famous portrait, wondering if the lady likes dogs. Hand-assembled and framed by Melon Glow Books.

- Dark walnut-finish wood frame, 10 x 12 in
- White mat with 5 x 7 in window
- Engraved brass plaque
- Choose English or French plaque
- Glazed front, ready to hang
- Shipped in a fitted corner-protector box

The French plaque is a built-in conversation piece: visitors ask what it says, and the answer always earns a smile.

A natural companion to Pepper's Museum Shock on the shelf, and a standout gift for art lovers, dog lovers and anyone who has visited the Louvre.
